posts.title: Two Major Cybersecurity Firms to Combine in $44 Billion Deal
posts.description: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler, bulking up as worries about hacks fueled by advances in artificial intelligence bedevil companies and governments.

posts.title: Wall Street Set to Bounce Back After Tech Sell-Off
posts.description: Early stock market moves pointed to some stability when regular trading resumes in the United States on Monday, partly reversing a sharp fall last week. But analysts warned of more volatility ahead.

posts.title: Ukrainian Attack Off Coast of Libya Shows Reach of Kyiv’s Naval Drones
posts.description: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that Ukrainian drones sank a corvette and hit a dry cargo vessel, in attacks that involved special operations forces.
